unreleased · not-yet-boun

Package installation

The release package contains the public manager and proprietary engine object code. It never contains engine source, build inputs, model tables as standalone files, or a compiler.

Release-candidate shape. The final registry names are fixed, but publication is still gated by legal approval, production signing, native platform evidence, registry credentials, and a separate release approval.

npm

npm install -g @kleos-research/kaleidoscope
kscope --version

@kleos-research/kaleidoscope is the platform-neutral entry package. It resolves one exact optional companion, such as @kleos-research/kaleidoscope-darwin-arm64, for the installing machine. The companion carries the source-free native payload and its bound public contract. Do not install with --omit=optional.

Python

python -m pip install kaleidoscope-memory

kaleidoscope-memory is the Python facade. A platform wheel, such as kaleidoscope-memory-native-darwin-arm64, carries the same signed native payload and is selected by the facade. There is no source distribution fallback that compiles or downloads the private engine.

What the package checks

  • Exact manager, engine, public-contract, SBOM, provenance, and signature bindings.
  • Allowlisted tarball/wheel inventories with private-source and build-path scans.
  • Offline installation, executable permissions, kscope --version, and clean update/rollback/uninstall rehearsals.
  • Unsupported or untested targets fail clearly; matrix entries do not imply support.

Current availability

The local macOS arm64 candidate passes the package and lifecycle lanes. The final-name package metadata is staged at SDK commit {SDK_PACKAGE_METADATA_COMMIT}. Its signature is test-only and the artifacts are not published. Other platform cells, production EULA/license text, trusted signing identities, registry publication, and Pages promotion remain protected gates.
